Done. Batches 7, 8 and 9 are clean.

## What was flagged and fixed

| batch | flagged rows | status changes | kept `not_applicable` with `reviewed` uphold |
|---|---|---|---|
| 7 (Brownian Markov/hitting, 57 items) | 31 | 7 | 5 |
| 8 (Itô calculus, 56 items) | 301 | 21 | 11 |
| 9 (AHSS/Chern classes, 70 items) | 542 | 1 | 2 |
| **total** | **874** | **29** | **18** |

Every one of the 874 flagged rows was read against its item (claim, facts, boundary-relevant proof steps or definition text) and rewritten. All 874 rewritten rows carry distinct text — no sentence is reused between items.

**Statuses corrected (29).** 15 `not_applicable → checked` because the item's own text really discharges the axis — e.g. the two biconditionals proved in (c)/(d) of `def-continuous-time-stopping-time`, the definitional translation identity in `def-brownian-motion-started-at-x`, the "exactly when" covariance identity in `cor-deterministic-ito-integrals-are-gaussian`, the empty root list handled by `ch(0)=0` in `def-chern-character-of-a-complex-vector-bundle`. 14 `checked → not_applicable` because the axis does not occur — the two scope remarks (`rem-ito-versus-stratonovich-boundary`, `rem-general-semimartingale-calculus-is-outside-this-block`) assert no claim with a boundary case and attach no proof, and three endpoints rows sit on pointwise operators/subspaces with no interval.

**No proof gap was found and none was hidden.** No item's proof omits a case its own Statement makes obligatory; the 14 downgrades are axes that do not arise, not missing cases. No row was left at a "gap" value.

**Upholds (18).** Where a detector's regex fires on a correct `not_applicable` row (a `\bigcup`/`\bigcap`/`\sum` or "family" over a nonempty index set, or a definitional subordinate "exactly when"), the row keeps its `not_applicable` text plus a hash-bound `reviewed: {upheld, by: "alpha-high/step3b-boundary-7-9", reason}` record, re-bound to the current item and row hashes.

## Checks actually run

- `node tools/boundary-audit.mjs <batch 7,8,9 files> --fail-on-contradicted --fail-on-template` → **exit 0**; no template clusters, no contradicted dispositions (also exit 0 per file).
- `node tools/proof-contract.mjs <each file> --strict` → 0 errors (57/57, 56/56, 70/70); the 3 `shotgun-bracket` warnings are pre-existing (identical on the pre-edit copies).
- `tools/merge-proof-contracts.mjs` over my three files → 183 items, no duplicate/scope errors; the merged copy also audits clean.
- Byte comparison vs. pre-edit files: 874/874 flagged rows changed, 0 unchanged, 0 missing; `version`, `scope`, contract order, `citations`, `derivations`, `routine_steps`, row order and case names untouched; all 18 review hashes current.

## Report and open obligation

Report written to `research/phase-2-remaining-27-boundary-cleanup-7, 8, 9-report.md` with fixed rows, status changes, the (empty) list of items needing a real boundary case, the final audit output, and the checks run.
